requirements.hint: At least 90 credits must come from standard coursework; internships and independent study don't count.

requirements.hint: Credits earned in courses outside the Classical Studies department(s).

requirements.hint: At least 90 credits must carry a letter grade (transfer and test credit included).

requirements.label: 30 Credits Taken While Enrolled in LSA
requirements.hint: Credits earned while officially enrolled in LSA (as opposed to another U-M college).

requirements.label: Elementary Greek
requirements.hint: GREEK 101 and GREEK 102, or GREEK 103 (intensive). Complete one of the two paths below.

requirements.label: GREEK 101 and 102: Elementary Greek
requirements.hint: Both GREEK 101 and GREEK 102.

requirements.label: GREEK 103: Intensive Elementary Greek I
requirements.hint: One intensive course covering the elementary Greek sequence.

requirements.label: 4 GREEK Courses at the 400-Level or Above
requirements.hint: Any GREEK courses numbered 400 or above, such as GREEK 401, 402, 410, 437, 462, 495, 499, 506, or 556.

requirements.label: 2 GREEK Courses at the 300-Level or Above
requirements.hint: 2 GREEK courses numbered 300 or above (for example GREEK 301, 302, or 307), beyond the 4 courses used for the 400-level requirement.

requirements.label: Introductory Greek Civilization Course
requirements.hint: Choose 1 of: CLARCH 221 or HISTORY 200. ARCHAM 221 is the current catalog code for CLARCH 221 per the department checklist.

requirements.label: Upper-Level Greek Civilization, Archaeology, or History Course
requirements.hint: Still building automatic checking for this rule. One upper-level (300- or 400-level) course in Greek civilization, archaeology, or history, minimum 3 credits. The department defines this by topic rather than a fixed course list; the Greek Major Checklist (Classical Studies, effective Fall 2024) shows one blank line each for a Greek Civilization, Greek Archaeology, or Greek History course, typically from CLCIV, ARCHAM (formerly CLARCH), or HISTORY offerings. Until then, confirm progress with your advisor.

requirements.label: Major Total: 24 Credits
requirements.hint: Still building automatic checking for this rule. Minimum 24 credits from all courses used toward the major (Greek language courses, the intro civilization course, and one upper level Greek civilization, archaeology, or history course; prerequisites excluded). The civilization course has no published list, so this total cannot be counted automatically. Until then, confirm progress with your advisor.
